text: 万科A发布异动公告，公司A股股票连续三个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%。根据《深圳证券交易所交易规则》及有关规定，属于股票交易异常波动。近期公司经营情况稳定，内外部经营环境未发生重大变化。公司在定期报告中已披露，2026年公司将聚焦化险和发展两大主题，坚定推进城市与业务聚焦，持续提升产品与服务能力，同时也将持续通过存量资源盘活和大宗资产交易，通过落实再融资、展期等融资优化举措，实现公司资债结构的优化、有序缓释到期偿付压力、稳妥处置债务风险。目前公司正持续推进相关工作。公司未发现近期公共传媒报道了可能或已经对公司股票交易价格产生较大影响的未公开重大
text_en: China Vanke A issued an abnormal fluctuation announcement that the closing price deviation of its A-shares exceeded 20% cumulatively over three consecutive trading days. According to the "Shenzhen Stock Exchange Trading Rules" and relevant provisions, this constitutes abnormal stock trading fluctuation. Recently, the company's operating conditions have been stable, and no major changes have occurred in the internal and external operating environment. The company has disclosed in its periodic reports that in 2026, the company will focus on the two major themes of risk resolution and development, firmly advance city and business focus, continuously improve product and service capabilities, and will also continue to optimize the company's asset-liability structure, orderly ease maturity repayment pressure, and properly handle debt risks through revitalizing existing resources and bulk asset transactions, and through implementing refinancing, extensions, and other financing optimization measures. Currently, the company is continuously advancing related work. The company has not found any undisclosed major information recently reported by public media that may or has already had a relatively large impact on the company's stock trading price.
